title: Singapore Wonders | From Heritage Hues to Modern Skylines
highlights: Discover Singapore, the iconic Lion City and marvel at its stunning attractions and amazing experiences, all curated to offer an insight into its beauty and heritage.
Enjoy up to 20% savings with exclusive vouchers and discount coupons at popular food outlets across Singapore, letting you savour local delicacies and global cuisines.
Explore Universal Studios Singapore, Southeast Asia’s only Hollywood-themed park, where immersive zones and live shows deliver a full day of cinematic thrills.
Enjoy Night Safari at Mandai, the world’s first nocturnal wildlife park, where open tram trails bring nocturnal habitats alive with prowling big cats and rainforest calls.
Stay in handpicked hotels offering bigger-sized rooms, combining comfort and style for a more relaxed and memorable stay in Singapore.
Book this package for 5 or more adults and enjoy a complimentary Marina Bay Sands evening slot upgrade with comfortable return private transfers.
overview:
About the Tour:
Discover Singapore in 5 days with a balanced blend of leisure and must-see moments. Ease in on arrival with a leisurely Changi stroll—Butterfly Garden, Sunflower Garden and kinetic art. Meet the city’s wild side at Bird Paradise and the Night Safari. Explore by day on a curated city tour, then rise to Marina Bay Sands SkyPark, wander Gardens by the Bay’s Floral Fantasy and catch the amazing Garden Rhapsody show. Cap it with a full day at Universal Studios and the magical Wings of Time.

know_before_you_go: The local currency is the Singapore Dollar (SGD), and both credit cards and digital payments are widely accepted.
English is commonly spoken, alongside Malay, Mandarin, and Tamil, which makes communication simple for visitors.
Public transport is highly efficient with the MRT and bus system, while Grab is a reliable option for taxis.
The weather remains hot and humid year-round, so pack light clothing, sunscreen, and an umbrella.
Smoking is not allowed in most public areas, and visitors must use designated zones.
Littering, jaywalking, spitting, and chewing gum in public are strictly prohibited and punishable by fines.
Drinking alcohol in public places is restricted between 10:30 PM and 7:00 AM.
Visitors should dress modestly when entering temples, mosques, or religious sites.
Always respect queues and follow local etiquette when using public transport or visiting attractions.
Some cultural and religious sites may not allow photography, so travelers should check for signage before taking pictures.
Attractions often have their own guidelines, such as no flash photography in gardens or aquariums, which should be followed to preserve the experience.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Singapore | Leisure Time at Changi Airport
days.desc: Welcome! Upon arrival at the airport, relish a meal at one of the Indian restaurants, Chutney Mary or Haldiram’s at the airport. Then, spend time exploring the attractions at the airport. You can stroll through the serene Butterfly Garden or feel the misty spray of Wonderfall. Also, you can marvel at the hypnotic Kinetic Rain sculpture, spot bright koi gliding in ponds or wander through the stunning Sunflower Garden. Later, get driven to the hotel. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel.

days.title: Leisure Time  | Visit to Mandai Wildlife Reserve
days.desc: In the morning, spend some time at your leisure, wherein you can explore attractions like Singapore Murugan Temple or Snow City. Later, in the evening, get driven to Mandai Wildlife Reserve. Begin at Bird Paradise, wandering & catching one of the flight presentations as the golden hour lights up the canopy. As dusk settles, enjoy a transition to the Night Safari, where you will board the guided tram to spot nocturnal wildlife in recreated habitats & explore walking trails for closer encounters.

days.title: Singapore Sightseeing Tour | Visit to Gardens by the Bay & Marina Bay Sands Sky Park
days.desc: Begin the day with a Singapore city tour. Enjoy Singapore Flyer for skyline views, wander Chinatown’s lanes & snap a shot against the Merlion at Marina Bay. Also, walk the Helix Bridge & admire ArtScience Museum, among various attractions. Later, get driven back to the hotel. Afterwards, get driven to Marina Bay Sands SkyPark & soak in the stunning sunset views. Next, head to Gardens by the Bay’s Floral Fantasy & admire its immersive displays, followed by an immersive Rhapsody show at Skytree.

days.desc: Today, get driven to the famous Universal Studios. Once there, explore the park with a guided map highlighting Thrillophilia’s must-do, adventure-filled attractions, ensuring you don’t miss any iconic experiences. From the adrenaline rush of Battlestar Galactica & Jurassic Park Rapids Adventure to family-friendly zones, the park offers something for everyone.
